# hallpass_api_target (Resource)

An HTTPS API (GitHub, Cloudflare, Google Cloud, …) agents call with their usual tools through the gateway's API proxy, which adds the credential of a `hallpass_api_access_profile` so agents never hold it. Agents trust the target's CA (`ca_certificate`), which can only sign certificates for its hosts. Destroying it deletes the target and its profiles: access ends and their credentials are destroyed. Import with the server ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_api_target" "github" {
  alias       = "github"
  description = "GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs"
  hosts       = ["api.github.com", "uploads.github.com"]
}

resource "hallpass_api_target" "gcp" {
  alias = "gcp"
  hosts = ["*.googleapis.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Unique name agents request access with. Gateway command words are reserved.
- `hosts` (List of String) HTTPS host names, exact (`api.github.com`) or `*.domain` wildcards (`*.googleapis.com`, every subdomain). No IP addresses; port 443 only. They must resolve to addresses the gateway's `api_proxy` settings allow (public addresses by default). Changing them issues a new CA.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, shown to operators.
- `display_name` (String) Display name (defaults to the alias).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the API target is enabled. Disabling ends active access within seconds and cancels pending requests; enabling lets policy decide again.
- `groups` (Set of String) Groups of the API target, used by policy selectors.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the API target, used by policy selectors.

### Read-Only

- `ca_certificate` (String) PEM certificate of the target's proxy CA, for agents to trust (they can also fetch it with `ssh <gateway> api ca`).
- `ca_fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the CA.
- `id` (String) Server ID (`srv_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hallpass_api_target.github srv_01hzxv3k4f8m9q2r5t7w0y6c1a
```
